an1.268:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo kañci saṅkhāraṃ niccato upagaccheyya, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.268:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ puthujjano kañci saṅkhāraṃ niccato upagaccheyya, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
an1.269:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo kañci saṅkhāraṃ sukhato upagaccheyya, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.269:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ puthujjano kañci saṅkhāraṃ sukhato upagaccheyya, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
an1.270:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo kañci dhammaṃ attato upagaccheyya, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati,
an1.270:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ puthujjano kañci dhammaṃ attato upagaccheyya, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
an1.271:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo mātaraṃ jīvitā voropeyya, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.271:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ puthujjano mātaraṃ jīvitā voropeyya, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
an1.272:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo pitaraṃ jīvitā voropeyya, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.272:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ puthujjano pitaraṃ jīvitā voropeyya, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
an1.273:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo arahantaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.273:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ puthujjano arahantaṃ jīvitā voropeyya, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
an1.274:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo tathāgatassa duṭṭhena cittena lohitaṃ uppādeyya, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.274:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ puthujjano tathāgatassa duṭṭhena cittena lohitaṃ uppādeyya, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
an1.275:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo saṅghaṃ bhindeyya, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.275:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati yaṃ puthujjano saṅghaṃ bhindeyya, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
an1.276:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddiseyya, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.276:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ puthujjano aññaṃ satthāraṃ uddiseyya, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
an1.277:1.1: aṭṭhānametaṃ bhikkhave anavakāso, yaṃ ekissā lokadhātuyā dve arahanto sammāsambuddhā apubbaṃ acarimaṃ uppajjeyyuṃ, netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
an1.277:1.2: ṭhānañca kho etaṃ bhikkhave vijjati, yaṃ ekissā lokadhātuyā eko arahaṃ sammāsambuddho uppajjeyya, ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
